title: Allbirds’ All-New Kiwi Collection Kickstarts Cozy Season
summary: The collection includes a boot, slipper and clog to bring comfort wherever you go
body_markdown:
**SAN FRANCISCO, November 4, 2025** – Allbirds is ushering in the coziest time of year with three all-new silhouettes that are a sensory overload of softness: the Kiwi collection, which includes the brand’s first-ever cozy boot and clog, plus a slipper.


This launch marks the debut of Allbirds' Relaxed category, a new strategic pillar designed to complement the brand's core Casual sneaker offerings. The Relaxed category, kicking off with Kiwi styles, is a direct response to consumer demand for shoes that combine at-home ease and stylish outdoor wear, proving that comfort doesn't have to stop at the front door. This comes as the brand also gears up to introduce its Elevated category in 2026, designed for formal and professional settings. Together, these three categories–Relaxed, Casual, and Elevated–will round out the brand's product offering and deliver Allbirds styles for a wider variety of use occasions.


“The Kiwi collection is a new expression of what we’re known and loved for, packaged in playful silhouettes that bring indoor-level comfort into everyday occasions,” said Adrian Nyman, Chief Design Officer, Allbirds. “This collection takes our commitment to comfort and translates that into new, exciting, and even unexpected styles. We’re expanding our horizons into a space that still feels inherently Allbirds, but with a fresh look that fans haven’t seen from us before.”


The collection comes with three effortless step-in styles that make it easy to slip into cloud-like fluff, no matter the winter occasion. Whether you’re holiday shopping around town, enjoying après-ski, or cozying up by the fire, the Kiwi collection marries indoor comfort with outdoor style, so you can bring a warm and fuzzy feeling wherever you go.


In a nod to Allbirds’ New Zealand roots, this trio of styles draws inspiration from the Kiwi—the nation's iconic bird known for its soft, fluffy feathers. Each silhouette is crafted with cozy, recycled wool felt uppers and lined with a soft-to-the-touch wool blend fluff, all underpinned by Allbirds’ signature SweetFoam® midsole and full rubber outsole to lend luxurious comfort and traction.


The Kiwi collection–including the Kiwi Slipper ($95 USD), Kiwi Clog ($110) and Kiwi Boot ($130)–is available online and in-stores beginning November 4, 2025.


**About Allbirds, Inc.**


Allbirds is a global modern lifestyle footwear brand, founded in 2015 with a commitment to make better things in a better way. That commitment inspired the company’s first product, the now iconic Wool Runner; and today, inspires a growing assortment of products known for superior comfort. Allbirds designs its products to be materially different by turning away from convention toward nature’s inspiration with materials like Merino wool, tree fiber and sugarcane.
